title: Comments: can't leave a comment on an arrow
reason: Reports hosted comment pins being rejected or detached when placed on arrow shapes and requests anchors that follow arrow movement. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no hosted comments/anchor service, so this is not an arrow binding defect in the local editor.

title: Comments: prevent editing a comment while composing a new one
reason: Asks whether the comments UI should prevent editing an existing comment while a new comment composer is open, even though editing two existing comments is already disallowed. The issue includes a screenshot/video reference; it was not replayed.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is an unresolved state-design question in the upstream comment composer; Varve has no equivalent comment editing surface.

title: Comments: add a read state to the notifications panel
reason: The reply confirms #9471 and #9822 implemented per-row unread dots, All/Unread filtering, mark-all-read, and marking a notification read on open.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no hosted comments notification panel; the upstream implementation is out of scope.

title: Comments: the area between a comment pin and its composer isn't zoomable
reason: Reports an uncovered region between a hosted comment pin and composer swallowing canvas wheel events, while preserving composer-internal scrolling; described as follow-up to #9698. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: The event overlay path depends on comments UI absent from Varve; no canvas wheel regression is inferred.

title: Comments: clarify what unchecking Show all comments does
reason: Requests explaining the unchecked state of a hosted comment filter instead of labeling only the checked state. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: No corresponding comments filter exists in Varve.

title: Comments: close the reaction picker after adding a reaction
reason: Requests dismissing the reaction picker after selection and returning focus to the thread, with a noted open question about multi-reaction selection. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: This concerns the hosted comment reaction UI, which Varve does not implement.

title: Comments sidebar closes when clicking the comments button while another tool is active
reason: Reports a toolbar button that closes the sidebar as a toggle even when another tool is active, instead of selecting the comment tool. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no comments tool or hosted comment sidebar to reproduce this state mismatch.

title: Comments: comment area max height is too short
reason: Requests a more responsive or larger maximum comment area so ordinary content needs less scrolling. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is a layout tuning request for an absent Varve feature surface.

title: Comments: replying to a thread wrongly notifies you that the thread author replied
reason: Reports a hosted notification that attributes one's own thread reply to the original thread author. No comments or reproduction details were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no comments notifications or multiplayer event recipients to evaluate.

title: Select all then copy/paste in a comment text box adds line breaks
reason: Reports extra line breaks after keyboard select-all/copy/paste in a single-line hosted comment input, while pointer selection does not reproduce the issue. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: No equivalent hosted comment input exists in Varve; clipboard behavior was not reproduced locally.
